verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of verification funnel analytics such as pass rates, drop-off points, or completion time broken down by country or document type. The only analytics mentioned are Cases analytics for SLAs and case resolution rates, which is an adjacent operations-review feature. API status polling and webhooks are building blocks a developer could use to build their own funnel reporting, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see verification funnel analytics — pass rates, drop-off points, completion time by country and document type — to know what verification is costing me in signups
